item.title: No sign yet of 'hundreds of dead birds', Doc says
item.description: Initial investigations into claims of hundreds of dead birds around the Lake Te Anau shoreline have so far turned up nothing out of the ordinary.

item.title: Victim nabs stolen tools back from burglar
item.description: A quick-thinking member of the public led police to a burglar after spotting their own stolen tools on Facebook Marketplace.

item.title: Global Insight: Govt urged to show international leadership
item.description: Young people want New Zealand politicians to show leadership on the world stage, Prof Robert Patman says.

item.title: Law change removes retrospective employment status challenge for contractors
item.description: Workplace Relations Minister Brooke van Velden. Photo: RNZ By Lillian Hanly of RNZ The government is tweaking its legislation removing the right for contractors to challenge their employment status to make clear that it will not be applied retrospectively.

item.title: Reserve Bank review was originally due to be finished by March
item.description: Finance Minister Nicola Willis. Photo: RNZ By Giles Dexter of RNZ A review into the Reserve Bank's monetary policy decisions during the Covid-19 pandemic was originally intended to be completed by March.

item.title: Person seriously injured as classic car mangled on motorway
item.description: One person has been seriously injured in a crash north of Dunedin.

item.title: Govt increases NZ space launch limit to 1000
item.description: Photo: Supplied/Rocket Lab via RNZ A physics professor says he does not trust the New Zealand Space Agency to make good decisions about a likely host of new space launches.

item.title: Concern for wellbeing of seafarers on anchored former Interislander ship
item.description: The Aratere ferry has been renamed Vega and sold to India - yet it remains in New Zealand waters. Photo: Supplied / Jason Grimmett via RNZ By Samantha Gee of RNZ The Maritime Union of New Zealand is concerned about the wellbeing of seafarers on board the former Interislander ferry Aratere, now called the Vega, which is anchored in Tasman Bay waiting to sail to India.

item.title: QLDC initiates road safety video for international tourists
item.description: Queenstown Lakes District Council has teamed up with local police to create videos for tourists promoting safe driving in the region.
